author: TeIq
content: Implementation complete. Migration 13 extends labels with subject_did/label_cbor/signing_did/signed_at + UNIQUE on action_id + 64-byte sig CHECK. LabelEmitter (Arc<dyn SigningKey>+PgPool+LabelBroadcaster) builds proto-blue Label, canonical-CBOR via lex_json+lex_cbor, signs with K-256, persists. Wired into submit_action handler best-effort. 8 unit tests + 3 testcontainers integration tests pass (including AC-3 proto-blue decode round-trip + sig verification + tamper detection + takedown negation + idempotency + end-to-end HTTP route).
